screening_decisions.reason: Prospective randomized clinical study comparing biocompatible polyacrylonitrile membranes (BCM) with bioincompatible cuprophane membranes (BICM) in 72 adult patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all selection criteria.
Historical review/observational study discussing hemodialysis effects on renal recovery. Not a randomized trial comparing BCM vs BICM.
Prospective observational study assessing prognostic factors in ARF. While it mentions membrane type associations, it is not a randomized trial comparing BCM vs BICM.
Prospective randomized study comparing cuprophane (BICM) with polyacrylonitrile (BCM) in 52 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomized trial comparing two synthetic membranes (both biocompatible). Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses hemofiltration rather than intermittent hemodialysis.
Meta-analysis of myocardial infarction trials. Completely unrelated to ARF or dialysis membranes.
Small study (10 patients) using hemofiltration rather than intermittent hemodialysis. No clear randomization described.

Randomized trial comparing cellulose acetate (modified cellulose with lower biocompatibility) with polysulfone (BCM) in 66 adult patients with ARF requiring intermittent hemodialysis. Meets selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of previously published trials. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques. Not a clinical trial on ARF or dialysis membranes.
Study comparing membrane types in 57 ARF patients, but randomization is not clearly described in the abstract. Cannot confirm it meets RCT criteria.
Observational study analyzing prognostic factors in acute tubular necrosis. Not a randomized trial comparing membrane types.

Randomized trial comparing two synthetic membranes (PAN vs polysulfone, both biocompatible). Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses continuous venovenous dialysis rather than intermittent hemodialysis.
Review article summarizing clinical trials. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Commentary discussing discordant meta-analyses. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Abstract contains only bibliographic references with no study description. Unable to assess eligibility.
Study about publication bias in oncology trials. Completely unrelated to ARF or dialysis membranes.
Review article about dialysate purity. Not a randomized trial comparing membrane types.
Study of pre-transplantation dialysis strategies in kidney transplant recipients. Different population than ARF patients requiring ongoing hemodialysis.
Observational analysis of ARF registry data. Not a randomized trial comparing membrane types.
Review article discussing dialysis variables. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Crossover randomized study comparing low-flux cellulose acetate (modified cellulose) with polysulfone (BCM) in 24 patients with ARF requiring intermittent hemodialysis. Meets selection criteria.
Prospective randomized study comparing cellulose diacetate (modified cellulose) with polysulfone (BCM) in 159 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets selection criteria.
Review article discussing membrane biocompatibility concepts. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial comparing two synthetic membranes (low-flux polysulfone vs high-flux polyacrylonitrile). Both are biocompatible; does not compare BCM vs BICM.
Observational study using USRDS data in chronic hemodialysis patients (>1 year). Not ARF patients, not a randomized trial.
Prospective randomized multicenter trial comparing Cuprophan (BICM) with polymethyl-methacrylate (BCM) in 180 patients with dialysis-dependent ARF. Meets all selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of ACE inhibitor trials in chronic nondiabetic renal disease. Not about ARF or dialysis membranes.
Review article on renal replacement therapies. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial comparing dialysis modalities (EDD vs CHD), not membrane types. Does not compare BCM vs BICM.

Prospective multicenter study with quasi-randomized allocation (alternating order) comparing BCM with BICM (cellulosic) in 153 patients with ARF requiring dialysis. Meets selection criteria as quasi-randomized trial.
Post-hoc analysis of observational data from French Prospective Multicenter Study. Membrane type was not assigned by protocol (centers followed usual practice). Not a randomized trial.
Randomized trial comparing two synthetic membranes (both biocompatible). Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses continuous hemofiltration rather than intermittent hemodialysis.
Expert discussion forum on ARF pathophysiology. Not a clinical trial.
